description: Controlled vocabulary defining canonical microwave backhaul failure modes recognized by A.R.I.A. Manufacturer-specific manifestations, products, procedures, evidence patterns, and historical probabilities are connected separately through the Knowledge Graph and Experience Ledger.

failure_modes.name: ANTENNA_MISALIGNMENT
failure_modes.description: Antenna pointing differs sufficiently from the required path alignment to degrade RF performance.

failure_modes.name: AZIMUTH_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Horizontal antenna pointing differs from the required path azimuth.

failure_modes.name: ELEVATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Vertical antenna pointing differs from the required path elevation.

failure_modes.name: CROSS_POLARIZATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Polarization alignment or discrimination is incorrect or insufficient for the applicable system.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_POLARIZATION
failure_modes.description: Installed or configured polarization does not match the required design or corresponding path endpoint.

failure_modes.name: RF_CHAIN_CONNECTION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: One or more RF-chain components are connected incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_PORT_ROUTING
failure_modes.description: An RF path is physically routed through the wrong equipment port or path.

failure_modes.name: MAIN_DIVERSITY_ROUTING_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Main and Diversity RF paths are connected, assigned, or routed incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: LOOSE_RF_CONNECTION
failure_modes.description: An RF connection is not properly seated, secured, torqued, or mechanically retained.

failure_modes.name: DAMAGED_RF_COMPONENT
failure_modes.description: A physical RF component is damaged sufficiently to affect operation.

failure_modes.name: DAMAGED_WAVEGUIDE
failure_modes.description: Waveguide or equivalent RF transmission medium is physically damaged, deformed, contaminated, or otherwise impaired.

failure_modes.name: WATER_INGRESS
failure_modes.description: Moisture or water has entered an RF component, connection, waveguide, cable, or interface.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_RF_COMPONENT
failure_modes.description: Installed RF component is not the required or compatible component for the applicable design.

failure_modes.name: RF_COMPONENT_MATING_ERROR
failure_modes.description: RF components that require specific orientation, mating, engagement, or interface conditions are assembled incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: RADIO_HARDWARE_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Radio hardware is malfunctioning or incapable of performing its required RF or system function.

failure_modes.name: TRANSMITTER_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Radio transmitter fails to produce the required RF output or behaves outside expected operating limits.

failure_modes.name: RECEIVER_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Radio receiver fails to correctly receive, detect, or report the incoming RF signal.

failure_modes.name: RADIO_PATH_ASSIGNMENT_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Radio A, Radio B, Main, Diversity, or another logical RF path is assigned incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: GENERAL_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: One or more equipment configuration values do not match the required operational state.

failure_modes.name: FREQUENCY_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Configured transmit or receive frequency does not match the required channel plan or corresponding endpoint.

failure_modes.name: CHANNEL_BANDWIDTH_MISMATCH
failure_modes.description: Configured channel bandwidth is incorrect or inconsistent between required system elements.

failure_modes.name: TX_POWER_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Configured transmit power or applicable transmit-power control setting is incorrect.

failure_modes.name: ATPC_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Automatic Transmit Power Control configuration, target, limits, state, or associated parameters are incorrect.

failure_modes.name: MODULATION_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Configured modulation, adaptive modulation, coding, or related capacity parameters are incorrect.

failure_modes.name: TOPOLOGY_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Equipment is configured for the wrong topology, protection arrangement, aggregation mode, or radio architecture.

failure_modes.name: MAIN_DIVERSITY_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Main and Diversity paths are logically configured or associated incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: ENDPOINT_CONFIGURATION_MISMATCH
failure_modes.description: Corresponding microwave endpoints contain incompatible or inconsistent configuration values.

failure_modes.name: WRONG_CONFIGURATION_TEMPLATE
failure_modes.description: Configuration derived from an incorrect template, site, product, topology, frequency, or deployment context.

failure_modes.name: FIRMWARE_DEFECT
failure_modes.description: Installed firmware contains a defect affecting expected system operation.

failure_modes.name: FIRMWARE_COMPATIBILITY_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Installed firmware is incompatible with hardware, configuration, topology, management software, or another system component.

failure_modes.name: SOFTWARE_CONFIGURATION_STATE_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Software or management-system state does not accurately reflect or correctly control the intended equipment state.

failure_modes.name: LINE_OF_SIGHT_OBSTRUCTION
failure_modes.description: A physical object obstructs or materially intrudes into the microwave propagation path.

failure_modes.name: INSUFFICIENT_FRESNEL_CLEARANCE
failure_modes.description: Required Fresnel-zone clearance is not maintained.

failure_modes.name: PATH_DESIGN_ERROR
failure_modes.description: An engineered path parameter or assumption is incorrect or unsuitable for actual deployment conditions.

failure_modes.name: PATH_ENDPOINT_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Antenna or system is aligned, configured, or constructed toward an incorrect endpoint.

failure_modes.name: ANTENNA_HEIGHT_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Installed antenna height differs materially from the required path design.

failure_modes.name: RF_INTERFERENCE
failure_modes.description: Undesired RF energy degrades receiver or link performance.

failure_modes.name: CO_CHANNEL_INTERFERENCE
failure_modes.description: Interference is produced by another signal operating on the same or effectively overlapping channel.

failure_modes.name: ADJACENT_CHANNEL_INTERFERENCE
failure_modes.description: Energy from a neighboring channel materially affects receiver performance.

failure_modes.name: RAIN_ATTENUATION
failure_modes.description: Precipitation causes additional microwave path attenuation.

failure_modes.name: ICE_OR_SNOW_ACCUMULATION
failure_modes.description: Ice or snow accumulation affects antenna, radome, RF components, structure, or propagation.

failure_modes.name: WIND_INDUCED_MISALIGNMENT
failure_modes.description: Wind loading causes temporary or persistent antenna pointing error or structural movement.

failure_modes.name: TEMPERATURE_RELATED_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Equipment or a component behaves incorrectly because of temperature or thermal conditions.

failure_modes.name: POWER_SUPPLY_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Required equipment power is absent, unstable, outside tolerance, or otherwise unsuitable.

failure_modes.name: LOW_INPUT_VOLTAGE
failure_modes.description: Equipment input voltage is below the applicable operating requirement.

failure_modes.name: POWER_CONNECTION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Power wiring, connector placement, polarity, termination, or related physical connection is incorrect.

failure_modes.name: INSTALLATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Equipment or supporting infrastructure was installed incorrectly.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_HARDWARE_INSTALLED
failure_modes.description: Installed hardware does not match the required design, bill of material, compatibility requirement, or intended application.

failure_modes.name: ORIENTATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: A component is physically installed in an incorrect orientation.

failure_modes.name: MISSING_COMPONENT
failure_modes.description: A required component is absent from the installed system.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_REFERENCE_DATA
failure_modes.description: Troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, or configuration is being performed using incorrect or outdated reference information.

failure_modes.name: INCORRECT_DESIGN_DATA
failure_modes.description: Engineering or design information contains an error affecting implementation or diagnosis.

failure_modes.name: SITE_IDENTIFICATION_ERROR
failure_modes.description: Information, configuration, files, or actions are associated with the wrong site, path, endpoint, or project.

failure_modes.name: UNDETERMINED_FAILURE
failure_modes.description: Available evidence establishes that an abnormal condition exists but does not yet support a sufficiently specific failure classification.

semantic_rules.rule: A registered failure mode represents a technically possible class of failure and does not independently establish probability, occurrence, or causation in a specific case.

Manufacturer-specific failure manifestations shall connect to canonical failure modes through Knowledge Graph entities and relationships rather than creating duplicate manufacturer-specific failure classes unless the failure mechanism is genuinely distinct.
ARIA shall prefer the most specific failure mode justified by available evidence while preserving broader parent classifications when useful for reasoning.
A symptom shall not be treated as a failure mode unless evidence establishes the underlying failure condition.
Multiple failure modes may remain simultaneously active hypotheses during diagnosis.
Historical occurrence rates belong to the Experience Ledger and probabilistic reasoning layers and shall not be encoded as fixed probabilities in this registry.
UNDETERMINED_FAILURE is permitted when evidence is insufficient for a more specific classification and shall not be used merely to avoid continued diagnostic reasoning.
